content:
The failure was stopped by rolling back the card‑processor‑proxy deployment. At 09:10 the on‑call engineer ran  

```bash
kubectl -n payments rollout undo deploy/card-processor-proxy
```  

which reverted both card‑processor‑proxy‑01 and card‑processor‑proxy‑02 to the prior version. As the old version came back into service, the PAYAPI‑E1107 errors tapered off and stopped, and the incident was closed at 09:15.
name: gather
